The [[Isen system]] was in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It consisted of the highly [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Isen (star)|Isen]], the single [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Isen]] with its five [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]], and three [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belts]].<ref name="PoG1" />

The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located several hours [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel from [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]].<ref name="PoC">{{WEGCite|story=The Right Place ...|book=The Politics of Contraband|reprint=1}}</ref>

==History==
By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Isen system was in its birth throes, with a still-forming star and an endless sea of rock in orbit. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] survey teams designated four rough orbits on the supposition that these areas would eventually hold planets. The [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] of [[Isen]] was forming. The system was constantly bathed in [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]] emanating from the new star, and the asteroid debris made the system difficult to navigate.<ref name="PoG1" />

These factors made the [[Star system/Legends|system]] the ideal location for a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] base, leading the [[Void Demons]] pirate gang to construct a [[Void Demon pirate base|hidden base]] on the planetoid [[Isen IV]], fourth in orbit about the gas giant Isen.<ref name="PoG1" />

Due to the actions of the Void Demons, Isen IV became the site of several wrecked [[Starship/Legends|starship]] hulls. The asteroid was also home to the [[morvak]], unusual rock-eating creatures that were transported to the planetoid by one of the ships captured by the Void Demons.<ref name="PoG1" />
